description: Returns the status of an existing quote request. Requires both the request reference (TCB-…) and the e-mail address used for the request; returns no contact details.

locale.description: BCP 47 locale for names and messages: en, ja, zh-CN, zh-TW, ko, th, id, fr, de, es or it. Defaults to en.

name: get_quote_status
title: Get quote request status
